scope: Engineering pre-action public reference receipts and workflow source facts; no inference, simulation benchmark, training or user-goal IR
interventions: both; explicitly isolated in later ablations
acceptance: Version0/1 and default G unchanged; opt-in version2 requires explicit flags
Reference candidates come only from pre-dispatch observed reads, not hidden targets or extracted goal dependencies
Raw receipts retain request/response identity,ordinal,turn,SHA and UNKNOWN freshness; no guessed finish times
Limits remove whole rows and preserve all selection/omission counts
Workflow facts bound to unchanged native source SHA and public step fields
Native Home proves consecutive successful steps have same virtual clock; failure halts later steps
Native ReAct forwards context with unchanged query budget and actual tool calls
Reference-only and workflow-only flags operate independently; rules-only non-workflow input is identical to v1
Recursive hidden-field rejection and later-receipt exclusion verified; no automatic blocking or completion
stop_rule: A failed engineering check stops online review/ablation; preserve N72 original prompts,schema,requests,costs and failures unchanged
